2126285023347110128.en_summary: The bears say there is no AI demand in 2027 or 2028. False. Look at the data. Memory: Goldman has DRAM short 4.1% in 2026, 5.1% in 2027 and 1.2% in 2028. The 2027 gap is the widest in 15+ years. Suppliers: Samsung’s 2027 HBM sold out. SK hynix sees demand above supply through 2030. Micron has no line of sight to balance. NVDA says agentic AI demand for CPUs is far outstripping supply and sees CPU revenue more than doubling. GPUs: three-year-old H100 rents for $3.07/hour, up 54% in a year. Capex: cloud spending up another 60% in 2027 to about $1.5 trillion. AI demand is strong. Ignore the doomers.
2126285023347110128.zh_summary: 空頭說2027或2028年沒有AI需求。錯誤。看數據。記憶體：高盛預測DRAM在2026年短缺4.1%、2027年5.1%、2028年1.2%。2027年缺口是15年多來最寬。供應商：三星2027年HBM已售罄。SK海力士看到需求至2030年高於供應。美光沒有平衡的視線。NVDA表示代理AI對CPU的需求遠超供應，並看到CPU收入翻倍以上。GPU：三年前的H100每小時租金3.07美元，一年上漲54%。資本開支：2027年雲端支出再增60%，約1.5萬億美元。AI需求強勁。忽略末日論者。
